description: Pinning every image to a digest makes a rebuild reproducible; without something
to move those digests it also makes the stack permanently out of date, and a
stale digest is a security problem wearing a reproducibility costume. This is
the other half of the pin.
Digests are pinned alongside their tags (image:tag@sha256:...) so the file stays
readable: the tag says what it is, the digest says exactly which bytes.

packageRules.description: Group the observability stack. These are upgraded together or not at all — a Prometheus that has moved past its exporters is how a dashboard quietly empties.
Postgres majors are a migration, not an update: the data directory format changes and the container will refuse to start on an old one. Kept separate so it can never ride along in a group PR.
Go modules in both modules, batched. The server and the client share no dependencies by design, so these are genuinely independent.
Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule. Waiting until Monday to patch a known-exploited CVE is a policy that only looks tidy.
